metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Becoming Led Zeppelin
metas.description: The film traces the journeys of the four members of the Stairway To Heaven rockers through the music scene of the 1960s and their meeting in the summer of 1968, culminating in 1970.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Avicii - I'm Tim
metas.description: This is the story of Tim Bergling, a shy and insecure boy who, without realizing it, suddenly created one of the world's most loved artists - Avicii.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · I Am: Celine Dion
metas.description: A raw and honest behind-the-scenes look at the iconic superstar's struggle with Stiff Person Syndrome, a life-altering illness.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Jung Kook: I Am Still
metas.description: Jung Kook invites viewers on a journey showcasing his rise to stardom, creative process, work ethic, and challenges as a global icon, with unseen footage, interviews, and electrifying performances.

metas.name: ★ 8.1 · 2026 · Epic: Elvis Presley in Concert
metas.description: Follows Elvis Presley, featuring never-before-seen footage and recordings.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Music by John Williams
metas.description: Follows the life of legendary composer John Williams.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2025 · Latin Blood: The Ballad of Ney Matogrosso
metas.description: From a repressive childhood to artistic revolution, Ney Matogrosso transforms Brazil's stages - and himself - through music, creativity and inner fire.
